_note: Copy to the product as docs/delivery/plane.json (plane SPEC §8.1). Only project_id is required; add a package_docs block to opt into package-doc rules, and an architect block (SPEC §8.1) to turn on the architect seat: house rules, enforced passes, refactor capacity. suite.lanes.gate shows a gate as named stages, run in order until one fails; ccp adds the plane's doc checks as the last stage, so no stage calls ccp (SPEC §14.2). Write your own commands in place of these.
